name: Tulsi
medicinalUses: Reduces stress and anxiety, boosts immunity, relieves cold and fever, improves respiratory health, acts as an adaptogen.
cultivation: Thrives in warm, sunny climates. Needs well-drained fertile soil, regular watering, and full sun exposure. Grows well in pots.
desc: Revered across cultures as the 'Queen of Herbs', Tulsi is a cornerstone of Ayurvedic medicine with profound healing properties.

name: Ashwagandha
habitat: Dry regions of India, North Africa, Mediterranean
medicinalUses: Reduces cortisol levels, fights anxiety and depression, boosts testosterone and fertility, increases muscle mass and strength.
cultivation: Grows in arid conditions. Prefers sandy, loamy soil with good drainage. Drought-tolerant once established. Full sun preferred.
desc: An ancient medicinal herb from the Solanaceae family, revered for its restorative and rejuvenating properties in Ayurvedic medicine.

name: Neem
medicinalUses: Powerful antibacterial and antifungal. Treats skin disorders, dental issues, boosts liver health, purifies blood, acts as a natural pesticide.
cultivation: Fast-growing tree. Tolerates poor soils and drought. Grows in tropical climates with deep, well-drained soils.
desc: Known as the 'Village Pharmacy', every part of the Neem tree has therapeutic value making it one of the most versatile medicinal plants.

name: Turmeric
medicinalUses: Powerful anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. Relieves arthritis pain, improves brain function, lowers heart disease risk, helps fight depression.
cultivation: Tropical plant requiring warm, humid climate. Grows in well-drained, fertile loamy soil. Propagated through rhizomes.
desc: The golden spice of Ayurveda, Turmeric's active compound curcumin is one of the most scientifically studied natural medicines.

name: Brahmi
habitat: Wetlands and marshy areas across India & Australia
medicinalUses: Enhances memory and cognitive function, reduces anxiety, treats epilepsy, improves ADHD symptoms, protects brain cells.
cultivation: Aquatic or semi-aquatic plant. Thrives in wet, boggy conditions. Grows in shallow water or moist soil with full sun to partial shade.
desc: A revered brain tonic in Ayurveda, Brahmi has been used for thousands of years to sharpen intellect and enhance memory.

name: Aloe Vera
habitat: Arid regions, Arabian Peninsula, North Africa
medicinalUses: Heals burns and wounds, moisturizes skin, treats digestive issues, reduces dental plaque, lowers blood sugar levels.
cultivation: Succulent requiring minimal water. Grows in sandy, well-drained soil. Prefers bright indirect light. Drought-tolerant.
desc: A succulent wonder often called the 'plant of immortality', Aloe Vera's healing gel has been treasured for over 6,000 years.

name: Ginger
medicinalUses: Relieves nausea and vomiting, reduces muscle pain, lowers blood sugar, reduces cholesterol, helps fight infections.
cultivation: Tropical plant needing warm, humid conditions. Grows in rich, loamy well-drained soil. Partial shade preferred.
desc: One of the world's most ancient and beloved spices, Ginger's fiery warmth has been used medicinally across Asia for millennia.

name: Peppermint
habitat: Europe & Middle East, now cultivated worldwide
medicinalUses: Relieves IBS symptoms, reduces headaches, freshens breath, clears sinuses, improves energy and exercise performance.
cultivation: Hardy perennial. Grows in moist, well-drained soil with full sun or partial shade. Spreads rapidly via underground runners.
desc: A hybrid mint of extraordinary potency, peppermint's menthol provides instant cooling relief and has been valued since Ancient Egypt.
